entities.name: Petition Movement for the Establishment of a Taiwanese Parliament

entities.summary: Political movement which demanded that the imperial diet of japan establish a self-governing parliament, or representative assembly, in taiwan. Based in Empire of Japan. Founded/began: 1921.
